message: 最強に穿つ力と勇気

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, let's leave things here for today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the hard work~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Are you feeling okay today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Maybe my body is finally getting used to it. I'm feeling great today.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. That's great♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get it now. So that's how Demons fight.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Outsmarting the enemy is one valid tactic, yes, but you must also work on raising your baseline capabilities.」

name: Misa
message: 「However, we've only been studying; we haven't been doing any training to increase our Spirit Power.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It sure would be nice if there were sweets that made you stronger just by eating them, though.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no need to rush your enhancement. Listen carefully--for now, dedicate yourselves to mastering power that fits your current stature.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You will understand in due time. The day your true worth is put to the test is drawing near.」

name: Ria
message: 「Does that mean...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Allow me to update you on the current situation. Listen closely, alright?」

name: Melilot
message: 「First, we have discovered the magic circle that Soltia and Pasta planted on the academy grounds.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh~」

name: Melilot
message: 「We will attempt to destroy it in the near future. By doing so, we should be able to thwart the enemy's scheme.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that wraps everything up? Yeah, no way it's that easy.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The moment we begin the destruction, the enemy will notice our move...」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, they have likely already caught on. They are surely preparing countermeasures of some sort.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Carrying out the destruction of the magic circle in the field is my role. However, during that time... I will be completely defenseless and exposed to enemy attacks.」

name: Misa
message: 「And the ones attacking us will inevitably be...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is undoubtedly Soltia herself, the one who set up the magic circle」

name: Ria
message: 「Melilot-san can't fight. In that case, the ones taking on Soltia will be――」

name: Synn
message: 「Us, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn might be getting stronger, sure, but…… what about us……?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't lose your nerve, Nanaka-san! There must be things even we can do!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Let's do our best to back Synn-kun up, even if just a little」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone……」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems the angels dwelling within your Rosaries were once comrades who fought alongside the Demon Lord to prevent Re-Crea」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whaaat!? Even before us, angels and Demons were allies!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly is the one who told 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't tell me a single word about it until just now, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「My bad. I only just remembered it recently」

name: Melilot
message: 「As the Demon Lord's power grows, the angels will likely awaken their past memories and powers as well」

name: Melilot
message: 「I suspect Sage Paqy's memories were stirred and revived by that influence, too」

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon Lord and the angels…… so that's the kind of bond they had……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Judging by your reactions, asking to accompany the Demon Lord's training was……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Not the will of the angels…… but your very own will, wasn't it」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, your power has not yet reached a satisfactory level」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then does that mean they might try to take advantage of this opening and attack us!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There's no need to worry about that. For the time being, I am still able to act」

name: Melilot
message: 「The enemy has set a trap as well. As long as we don't make a move, it's highly unlikely they will strike first」

name: Melilot
message: 「In other words, our opponent isn't foolish enough to go out of their way just to get beaten」

name: Misa
message: 「I see. They wouldn't attack while Melilot-san's hands are still free」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's right」

name: Melilot
message: 「And that concludes the status report. Do you understand?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, got it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, excuse me」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, what is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you know what Virus is doing?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems hiding it was pointless. Since you asked, I'll tell you plainly」

name: Melilot
message: 「Condition, objective, actions. Everything about them is unknown」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, there's no need to feel anxious」

name: Melilot
message: 「After all, even if you all did something, you wouldn't stand a chance against Virus anyway」

name: Melilot
message: 「So don't do anything, and just focus on what you're supposed to do. Understood?」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot. If you beat around the bush like that, your true intentions won't get across at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Helena!」

name: Melilot
message: 「How else am I supposed to say it?」

name: Helena
message: 「Just telling them to leave what they don't know alone is fine, isn't it?」

name: Helena
message: 「It'll be okay. When push comes to shove... right?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because Synn... the Crusaders will find a way to handle it」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well... it may be impossible right now, but eventually it might be possible」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. So know your limits, and let's nurture that small strength until it grows great」

name: Helena
message: 「The courage and strength to stand up to Virus. If it's you all, I'm sure you can do it」
